hypothesis: A single DFlash forward producing 15 proposals can increase exact target tokens per combined draft-plus-verify second on the fixed c32 workload while preserving greedy target and KV semantics.

source_evidence.limitation: No exact-revision load, H200 acceptance, timing, endpoint, or quality result exists yet.

historical_integration_evidence.disposition: Request 25 is consumed and uninterpretable; never replay or classify it.

reusable_fix.rule: Use ForwardBatch.rids[row] for logical identity and req_pool_indices[row] to select target_worker.model_runner.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token.

required_contents: hash-complete exact target, tokenizer, draft, runtime, runner, owner, worker, command, and input identities
bounded durable mutable owner with generation-fenced release and same-claim repair
pre-science exact-revision load and shape checks
fixture-validated request-pool ownership mapping adopted before any observation
single-consumption markers for component and c32 observations
AR and NGRAM controls with identical target and instrumentation
per-round proposed and accepted drafts, commit lengths, first mismatch, and next-round logits/KV audits
CUDA-event interval-union accounting for draft, verify, acceptance, and KV commit

component_decision.close: Close this exact DFlash revision if immutable revisions fail to load for a model/shape reason, target/KV semantics fail after bounded integration repair, or combined producer-plus-verifier throughput is no better than both AR and NGRAM controls.
component_decision.promote: Promote only to a matched endpoint if exact semantics and KV audits pass, mean accepted drafts is positive, accepted target tokens per combined draft-plus-verify second exceeds both controls, and the measured margin makes a 20% endpoint reduction plausible.
component_decision.small_positive: Record any smaller positive gain as stackable component evidence without endpoint promotion.

conditional_bench.authority: No claim or lifecycle extension is authorized until this project's exact reservation and readiness artifact are both durable.

forbidden: claiming or readying a GPU before the reservation and source-packet gates
provider create, delete, SSH, Docker, CUDA, or endpoint traffic during the offline gate
changing target, tokenizer, draft revision, runtime revision, block size, workload, or controls
treating CPU source semantics as H200 performance evidence
